amos.2.p1.b1.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king.

amos.2.p1.b2.text: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth. … says the LORD.

amos.2.p1.b3.text: “For three transgressions of Judah, even four, … because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes;

amos.2.p1.b4.text: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.”

amos.2.p1.b5.text: “For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.

amos.2.p1.b6.text: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth; they push the needy out of their way.

amos.2.p1.b7.text: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. And in the house of their God, they drink wine obtained through fines.

amos.2.p2.b1.text: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, though his height was like that of the cedars, and he was as strong as the oaks. Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.

amos.2.p2.b2.text: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.

amos.2.p2.b3.text: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men. Is this not true, O children of Israel?”

amos.2.p2.b4.text: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

amos.2.p2.b5.text: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.

amos.2.p2.b6.text: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life. The archer will not stand his ground, … and the horseman will not save his life.

amos.2.p2.b7.text: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD.
